title: Sort, then prune
notes: Candidates 7 3 5 4 sort to 3 4 5 7, and the target is 10. Each loop stops at the first candidate bigger than what is left: after 3, 3, 3 only 1 is left, so that loop stops at once. 14 calls, with 9 branches pruned, find [3, 3, 4], [3, 7] and [5, 5]. Every list without pruning takes 125 calls.
